verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for an observability SaaS that stores customer logs, traces and metrics, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack has no content about retention periods, retention filters or deletion. The Log Management, Sensitive Data Scanner and Audit Trail items are bare titles, and scanning or redaction is an adjacent feature, not retention or deletion control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
